purpose: Weather engine rule table — maps daily market signals (general predict, sector board, Channel 1, event scanner) to a stance for every label family: favorable | neutral | hostile | unknown. THRESHOLDS AND RATIONALE TEXT LIVE HERE, so lessons can retune the weather without touching src/weather.py. Rule logic (which signals combine how) lives in code and should change rarely.

signal_notes.risk: general predict total_score vs risk_on/off thresholds
signal_notes.yields: 'Bond yields' factor score from general predict md: negative = yields rising = hostile for duration/junk, positive = yields falling
signal_notes.dollar_oil: 'Oil & dollar' factor score: negative = dollar and/or oil bid = tight conditions, bad for small caps and EM-ish beta
signal_notes.vix_ratio: Channel 1 vix.ratio (spot vs its own recent norm): > spike threshold = vol shock, < falling threshold = vol bleeding lower
signal_notes.fear_greed: Channel 1 fear_greed.value: extreme greed = speculative froth (junk rallies, reversal risk), extreme fear = washout
signal_notes.regime_corr: Channel 1 yield_spx_corr.corr_5d: negative = 'bad news is good news' regime (weak data rallies), positive = 'good news is good news'

family_notes.short: short:high and short:extreme are REGIME MULTIPLIERS — favorable means 'squeeze fuel if tape rises', hostile means 'stress amplifier if tape falls', never a flat bullish tag
family_notes.lev: leverage amplifies the running regime in both directions
family_notes.earn: proximity is a GATE (event risk), not a direction — the weather file lists it under gates, not stances
family_notes.industry_themes_geo: industry and theme stances are not scored daily in v1 (no per-industry predict exists yet); geo is only scored when the event scanner flags a region
